provenance.description: Phase-only advisory scheduling hypothesis with all 674 source hashes preserved. Latest successful measured nodes replace earlier observations; failed newer nodes retain their previous successful observation. First three shared-fixture groups retain consumer call/teardown plus one maximum observed cold setup. Fourth serial group retains both independent setup/call/teardown costs. No native quality-bound speed scaling is applied.
prediction_limitations: Advisory timing hypotheses, not acceptance evidence; no tests, numerical behavior, installs, deadlines or gates changed.
Latest current successful observations use Linux four, Mac three and Windows three local workers.
Costs retain setup/call/teardown only, with original shared-fixture grouping and both independent serial-proof setup costs.
Cross-replays hold measured node costs fixed. Reassignment can change host speed, contention, input caching and launch overhead.
Separate maximum observed parent/join and worker-other costs are added conservatively; no assumption bounds future host variation.
The primary matrix remains seven Linux/five Mac/eight Windows machines and four/three/three local workers.
The PR-repeat provenance records its actual checked-out revision, which can differ from the source branch revision.
